goal: Implement the approved loading/waiting/error/recovery presentation without changing the existing search lifecycle or discarding useful progressive results.
invariants: already-loaded valid results remain usable during progressive work where possible
stale async responses never overwrite a newer search
valid user input is preserved across recoverable failures
retry/recovery reuses the existing search lifecycle rather than creating a parallel one

checks: browser QA for initial loading, progressive refresh, transient error retry and completed-search recovery

done_when: loading states communicate progress without blocking useful already-loaded results
transient result refresh failures recover against the existing searchId where appropriate
stale async responses cannot overwrite a newer search
error and retry states do not reset valid user input unnecessarily
